CustomField.description:
Indication of the stage that the order has reached in the order business process.
You can add values to this picklist within two system-defined order status categories Draft: The order was just created and awaiting review Activated: The orders is active and ready to be managed Sent to SAP: The order was sent to SAP Order Received by SAP: SAP confirmed that the order reached their system. Not the management is done in SAP Paused: The order was put in hold from SAP or Salesforce side, the reason should had been provided. SAP Fulfil Execution: SAP is managing the order, the solution quotation was created and partially delivery may be in process. Shipping: The order is on its way to the final customer. Canceled: The order was canceled and the reason should had been provide Order Delivered: THe order was completly fullfilled and reached the customer. No further management is needed.
